name: Huntsman Malkhor's Bones
summary: Huntsman Malkhor's Bones are remains found in a sludge pit at Jintha'alor. Huntsman Markhor seeks them so his twin brother can receive a proper burial.

sections.title: A Brother's Remains
sections.body: At Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands, Huntsman Malkhor's Bones lie in a refuse pit among the Vilebranch's oozes. Huntsman Markhor asks you to recover them with his brother's skull. He hopes to take the remains to Yayo'jin for a proper burial.

faq.answer: Huntsman Malkhor's Bones lie in a sludge pit at Jintha'alor, near the top of the temple.
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village wants his twin brother's remains so he can arrange a proper burial.
Huntsman Malkhor was Huntsman Markhor's twin brother. The Vilebranch captured and killed him in a raid.
Markhor hopes to take Malkhor's remains to Yayo'jin for a proper burial.
The Vilebranch fed Malkhor's remains to the oozes and wolves at Jintha'alor.
